messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Thanks — that’s all we’re asking for. Keeps things running without disruption.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-10-19T10:29:00Z",
   "quote": "Thanks — that’s all we’re asking for. Keeps things running without disruption.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-15T11:14:00Z",
   "quote": "Will do — thanks for the support.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-18T12:10:00Z",
   "quote": "Happy to be part of it.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-22T12:46:00Z",
   "quote": "I appreciate that. We’re evaluating integrations next quarter — does your platform support API hooks for our legacy document system?",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-15T08:35:00Z",
   "quote": "We’ll need to lock in the demo slot for next Tuesday at 10am if that still works for your team, otherwise we’ll shift to Thursday. Morning Alwen, yes — we’re especially keen to see how your system manages supplier payments and integrates with our existing reporting tools.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-13T12:03:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Perfect — thanks Bryn. Looking forward to it.",
   "route": "support"
  }
 ],
 "title": "Thanks — that’s all we’re asking for. Keeps things running without disruption."
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The title and problem statement are a customer's thank-you note ('Thanks — that's all we're asking for. Keeps things running without disruption.'), which is praise, not a product problem. The quotes are sales/support logistics chatter (demo scheduling, thanks, an API capability question during evaluation) with no described defect, workaround, or actionable product issue. No squad could act on this.", "verdict": "fail"}
